usual_baseline: Renal and thyroid tests are usually done (78–94%); lithium levels, calcium and weight lag. 3-monthly levels 10% [3249], 44.4% [3479], 78% [3107]. Calcium 61.1–64% [3479][3348]; full compliance 12% with no calcium or BMI [3608]. Annual ECG 26% [3141]. Pre-lithium TFTs 4.2% and weight 0% in one unit [3567].
fix_that_works: Nurse-led or dedicated clinics and teams: all parameters over 85% [3681]; average 57% to 94% with levels, renal and calcium 100% [3304]; 12% to 68% fully compliant [3608]. A clinic proforma raised safety netting from 11.1% to 75% [3362]. Teaching lifted pre-lithium TFTs 4.2% to 61.6% and ECG 19.4% to 67.4% [3567].
fix_that_fails: Without a set intervention, 3-monthly levels moved only 10% to 17.5% and clinic documentation fell 67.5% to 62.5% [3249]. After a clinic and stickers, calcium stayed 8% and BMI 0% [3608]. Weight stayed below 40% after teaching [3567]. Weight/BMI and action on out-of-range results stayed weak [3304].
consultant_advice: Overdone, with 16 audits and the same answer. A lithium clinic or nurse-led system works; reminders and teaching help less. Don't re-audit blood tests. Audit whether abnormal results are acted on [3479][3516], plus calcium, weight and urine ACR, which stay poor even after clinics.
